items.title: 20.3 Benzene ki reactivity ka alkanes aur alkenes se muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of benzene with alkanes and alkenes (PDF 64).

blocks.text: Alkanes aam taur par kam reactive hain, kyunke yeh non-polar hain aur in mein sirf sigma bonds hain, halanke UV roshni mein yeh aasani se free-radical substitution karte hain. Alkenes bohat reactive hain: in ke pi electrons electrophiles ke liye dastiyab hain, aur yeh aasani se electrophilic addition karte hain.
Benzene ke paas bhi pi electrons hain, aur alkenes ki tarah yeh electrophiles se react karta hai, lekin do ahem farq ke saath:

items: Benzene bohat mustahkam aur is liye kam reactive hai.
Alkenes ke baraks yeh electrophilic substitution karta hai, electrophilic addition nahi.

blocks.text: Substitution aromatic ring ko bachata hai kyunke is ke pi electrons wasee taur par delocalised hain. Reaction aik darmiyani halat se guzarta hai jis mein aromaticity khatam hoti hai, lekin reaction mukammal hone par wapas aa jati hai, is liye ring ka kul istehkaam mutasir nahi hota. Addition delocalisation ko hamesha ke liye khatam kar deta, is liye pasandeeda nahi.

blocks.prompt: Benzene bohat unsaturated hai, phir bhi aasani se addition reactions nahi karta. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Addition delocalised pi nizam tor deta aur resonance energy (taqreeban 152 kJ/mol) kho deta, is liye tawanai ke lihaz se na-pasandeeda hai. Substitution mein ring ki aromaticity aakhir mein wapas aa jati hai, is liye benzene substitution pasand karta hai.

items: Alkanes: kam reactive, UV mein free-radical substitution.
Benzene: mustahkam; electrophilic substitution ring bachata.
